title: Fleet catalog entry
description: How one fleet server advertises itself to the Edison marketplace. Each servers/<id>/catalog-entry.json is one entry; edison-watch's sync upserts these into scripts/marketplace_connectors.json. Keep in lockstep with the structural checks in aggregate.py and with edison-watch's index_entry()/server_file() in scripts/generate_marketplace_entries.py.

id.description: Stable connector id; must equal the server directory name and the icon basename.

edison_hosted.description: First-party server Edison itself hosts and operates. Drives the Edison-hosted badge. Omit or false for OSS/self-host-only servers.

transport.description: How edison-watch reaches the server. 'http' (default when omitted): a remote streamable-HTTP endpoint Edison hosts (requires 'url'). 'stdio': a local process the SealGate daemon spawns on the user's machine (requires 'command' + 'args', no 'url'); use for servers that must run client-side, e.g. wrapping a local CLI like adb.

url.description: Public streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Ends in /mcp. Required for transport 'http'; forbidden for 'stdio'.

command.description: transport 'stdio' only: the executable the daemon spawns, e.g. 'npx' or 'uvx'. Must be on the user's PATH.

args.description: transport 'stdio' only: argv passed to 'command', e.g. ['-y', '@sealgate/android-adb-mcp']. May be empty but the key is required for stdio.

env.description: transport 'stdio' only: extra environment for the spawned process. Values may contain {PLACEHOLDER} tokens resolved from template_fields.env at install.

auth.description: edison-watch mount auth mode. 'token' resolves {PLACEHOLDER}s from template_fields.env; 'oauth' is 401-discovered; 'none' is open; 'edison-jwt' means Edison mints a per-user JWT and injects it (first-party servers only; requires edison_hosted, no user token). The fleet server's bearer mode maps onto 'token'.

headers.description: Required when auth == 'token'. Values may contain {PLACEHOLDER} tokens resolved from template_fields.env.

template_fields.description: Required when auth == 'token'. Install-time fields the user supplies.

icon.description: Icon filename, co-located in this server directory; sync copies it into frontend-v2/public/marketplace/icons/.

tools_configurations.description: Reviewed per-tool ACL + lethal-trifecta defaults baked into the install. Keyed by the tool's native name as the server exposes it (e.g. 'reddit_scrape'). REQUIRED and non-empty when edison_hosted is true OR transport is 'stdio' (see allOf): every marketplace install skips autoconfig auto-labeling, so a tool with no config mounts at the protective default (write + read_private + read_untrusted + SECRET) and trips the lethal-trifecta guard on first call. An individual tool still omitted from a present map keeps that protective default, so partial drift fails closed. edison-watch's generate_marketplace_entries.py carries these into servers/<id>.json; servers_validate.py applies them at install.

write_operation.description: True if the tool can modify external state (create/update/delete/send).

read_private_data.description: True if the tool can read private/sensitive data (not just public content).

read_untrusted_public_data.description: True if the tool reads untrusted external content (web, scraped pages, third-party APIs).

acl.description: Sensitivity of the data this tool handles.
